report:
### Conclusion
The claim that influenza vaccination causes Alzheimer's disease is **false**. Peer-reviewed scientific research demonstrates no causal link or increased risk. On the contrary, robust population-level studies show that receiving a flu shot is associated with a significantly reduced risk of developing Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia.

### Key Evidence
- **Scientific Consensus:** Medical organizations, including the Alzheimer's Association, explicitly identify the claim that vaccines cause or elevate the risk of Alzheimer's disease as a debunked myth (https://www.alz.org/alzheimers-dementia/what-is-alzheimers/myths).
- **Reduced Risk in Large Cohorts:** A nationwide study comparing flu-vaccinated and unvaccinated adults aged 65 and older found that receiving at least one flu vaccine was associated with a roughly 40% reduction in the four-year risk of developing Alzheimer's disease (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9484126/, https://neurosciencenews.com/flu-vaccination-alzheimers-20909/).
- **Consistent Findings Across Studies:** Comprehensive reviews find no peer-reviewed evidence linking vaccination to neurodegenerative decline; instead, evidence points toward a consistent protective correlation (https://www.alzdiscovery.org/cognitive-vitality/blog/is-there-a-link-between-alzheimers-disease-and-the-flu-shot).

### Biological Mechanisms Under Study
Researchers hypothesize that vaccinations may lower dementia risk by preventing severe infections that cause harmful systemic neuroinflammation, or by stimulating innate immune mechanisms that help clear misfolded proteins from the brain.

### Sources
- Alzheimer's Association Myths Page: https://www.alz.org/alzheimers-dementia/what-is-alzheimers/myths
- Risk of Alzheimer’s Disease Following Influenza Vaccination (PMC Study): https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9484126/
- Neuroscience News Report on Flu Vaccine Study: https://neurosciencenews.com/flu-vaccination-alzheimers-20909/
- Alzheimer's Drug Discovery Foundation Evidence Review: https://www.alzdiscovery.org/cognitive-vitality/blog/is-there-a-link-between-alzheimers-disease-and-the-flu-shot
